scripts.build: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'), fs=require('fs'); console.log('Installing frontend dependencies...'); execSync('npm --prefix frontend install', {stdio:'inherit'}); console.log('Building frontend...'); execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); console.log('Copied build to dist successfully.');"
